about_the_game:
The White Sea is the debut title from Spanish indie studio Shinrai Interactive, a psychological horror game set in a version of the United States during the 1980s and 1990s. Players will experience terror firsthand through a fully immersive 3D first-person perspective.

Allison Graham, a journalist for a well-known news network, is assigned to cover a story in White Sea, a town in northern Montana County that was abandoned and isolated by the federal government due to a series of disappearances that occurred in 1998, about 25 years ago.

Soon, she finds herself trapped in a twisted show where she has been chosen as the main participant. Nothing there is real, and she must confront her darkest traumas and memories from the past.

The White Sea captures the core elements of psychological horror and exploration like never before.

The game includes:

  • Atmospheric environments, an unsettling original soundtrack, and immersive, realistic graphics.

  • A gameplay based on exploration, puzzles and survival through mechanics strongly linked to the narrative.

  • Intense cutscenes that complement an enigmatic narrative.

content_descriptors.notes: Explicit scenes of violence and gore, such as bodies, mutilations, and bloody depictions of certain moments in history.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX with 3D audio support
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad/controller strongly recommended for optimal experience

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

  • Additional Notes: Gamepad/controller strongly recommended for optimal experience
